author: nick
frame_convention: raw = shipped video frame index; proxy frame = raw - frame_index_offset; every pixel is a raw-video pixel of the view
protocol: I clicked to place, not to accept. No marker was drawn. On every cell I clicked the very end of the pipette away from the coloured plunger button: the point of the disposable tip when one was on, the end of the cone when the pipette was bare. I pressed h when that end was not visible in the view, so hidden here means the end was hidden or outside the crop, and nothing else. Once per pipette per frame I pressed t for a disposable tip attached and b for a bare pipette, and the plunger colour I saw (keys 1 to 4); the tool wrote both on every view of that pipette on that frame. The small arrow at the crop's edge was the tracker's guess at the tip end (the long-thin-tail rule) and was never saved; a click that disagreed with it counts the same as one that agreed. When a crop showed a different pipette from the class in its caption, I clicked the end of the pipette I saw and named its colour, so the identity records which class was wrong (frame 600 in the head camera: the yellow cell showed the blue pipette with a tip on). The 8-channel pipette was left out of this sitting.
claim_boundary: Tip anchors are one person's clicks at the end of the white tip cone in two or three views on about 30 frames of one trial, triangulated through the rig; they inherit the rig's residual of a few pixels and the click's own scatter. They rank trackers against each other and read the pre-registered rule (median tip error under 2 cm); they are not ground truth and support no accuracy claim.
licence: FineBio is licensed for non-commercial research; frames and crops derived from it stay under runs/ and are never committed or redistributed. cells.json (frames, pixels of detector boxes and mask axes) and the human record (clicks, flags, identities) carry no image.
notes: Written by battle-finebio-tips export. tip_px is the clicked full-frame pixel (raw video pixels of the view), never the suggested tip; author and reviewed_at come from the decisions file and stay null until filled in. protocol, when given, is how I chose between a click and h in this session, and so what hidden means here. Crops stay under runs/.
